title: Independent candidate review: Chamorro, Shan, Tai Nüa
scope: All 95 Chamorro and 176 Shan non-null candidate values, plus seven Tai Nüa existing entries structurally only. Null target rows are not translated or completed by this review.
method: Independent model reading of actual target strings against canonical English; all 271 source fields matched canonical resource text after Android/XML text decoding. Candidate backtranslations were not used as acceptance authority. Direct inspection covered complete messages, lexical meaning, polarity, quantifiers, argument roles, Save versus export, copy versus original, and preservation claims. Narrow external references resolved selected vocabulary ambiguities, not a requirement to find published matching UI phrases.
limits: Not native-human certification. Accepted means this independent model review found wording semantically acceptable; it is not a production approval, compile/device/font check, or claim that the locale is complete. Corrected replacements are new independent-review proposals and have not received a further independent review. Uncertain and rejected entries must not be counted as accepted. No new Tai Nüa translation was produced.

verification.notes: Bounded text/key/placeholder consistency checks only; not an XML compiler or test suite. No production edits, full tests, merge or Work task.

references.use: Chung 2024 lexical cross-check: tinekcha' fruit; attura height; urihinåt original; putlumenus at least. Finder list explicitly is not a complete dictionary.
